speech.heard: In China, 97% of toddlers get basic DPT vaccines. In Sudan, it's 39%. China protects nearly all its young children against diphtheria, pertussis, and tetanus. Sudan is the world's lowest, where most toddlers lack full protection. Full protection requires three doses of vaccine during infancy. That gives China 2.5 times the immunization rate of Sudan. Across all nations, the median country sits at 91%. How high is childhood DPT immunization in your country?
